snippet.title: MOTORSLICE ► Launch Trailer For PC, PS5, Xbox Game Pass
snippet.description:
MotorSlice is OUT NOW! Get on Steam, GoG, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Game Pass!

Parkour through the ruins of a megastructure, climb massive bosses, and hunt down every piece of construction equipment in this slice of life anime action-adventure with immaculate vibes. In MOTORSLICE, step into the shoes of a girl named ‘P’ - an expert “Slicer” - and use everything at your disposal to complete a routine job gone wrong. Run, climb, slide, crouch, wall run, perform stunts, and even use your chainsaw to cross impossible distances, dodge traps - and find your prey. 

From smaller autonomous construction equipment, to massive mechas as tall as skyscrapers, make it through a hostile environment where everything wants to kill you. Strike first, or die. A single mistake can cost your life in a brutal clash of metal... but not everything can be solved with a chainsaw! Alone with a flashlight, the strange deserted expanses and labyrinthian liminal corridors call for ingenuity and wit as you parkour to the top. And then, between it all - take a breather with P, and catch her thoughts in interactive slice-of-life style cutscenes, where she muses on everything that’s happening around her.

Features:
- Fluid acrobatic traversal: Run, slide, wall-run, and parkour through brutalist landscapes and liminal spaces
- Colossal boss battles: Scale massive heavy machines to break them down to size
- High-risk, high-reward lethal combat: you die easily, but kill just as fast
- Interact with P as you traverse the megastructure: take selfies, pose, and engage in unique slice-of-life narrative scenes which contrast against intense action
- Featuring a banger Jungle/DnB soundtrack by Pizza Hotline

#motorslice #indiegame #anime
